  "answer": "ST-EVA holds 339 reported revenue observations for AAPL, covering periods from the fiscal year ending 2007-09-29 through the quarter ending 2026-06-27. The series is not a single comparable time series: it mixes quarterly (10-Q) and annual (10-K) filings, includes multiple restatements and amendments for the same periods, and combines two reporting frameworks — us-gaap (SEC filings) and a vendor source (YahooFinance). The us-gaap points use concepts us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet (earlier) and us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax (later), with mapping_fidelity shifting from PARTIAL to EXACT around 2017. The vendor point (obsarch_7429c7068c9299b29190bfba) covers 2023-07-01 to 2024-06-30 and is not on the same framework. All observations are SOURCE_REPORTED and UNVERIFIABLE (no cross-checks). The earliest reported annual revenue is $24.0B for FY2007 (obsarch_ddb4af888ab3c6be910c0f9e); the latest annual revenue is $416.2B for FY2025 (obsarch_34eea668c1419afbb7caccf2). Quarterly values are also present throughout.
